verdict.rationale: Vapi's Evals framework provides automated validation of assistant behavior via mock conversations and its Voice Test Suites use an AI tester to simulate calls and check outcomes, which is adjacent to automated call review, but neither is documented as automatically scoring, flagging failures in, or analyzing resolution of real production calls after the fact. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic post-call quality scoring on live/production transcripts, explicit failure-flagging analytics, and resolution-outcome analysis dashboards distinct from pre-production test suites.
